message.content:
1) CHARACTER: Ash-blonde/platinum hair in a messy high bun with loose framing strands; reddish-brown eyes, downward gaze; slender/petite doll-like build; visible ball-jointed doll seams at shoulders, elbows, hip, and knee; small blue anchor tattoo on upper chest; thin necklace.

2) CLOTHING STATE: White one-piece leotard with blue baroque/floral print and anchor emblem; covers chest, stomach, hips, crotch; legs and arms fully bare; pink ribboned ballet pointe shoes on both feet; under-fabric shape: subtle soft chest contour only, no explicit detail.

3) POSE: Airborne suspended aerialist/doll pose — one leg extended straight up high, other leg bent beneath; one arm raised overhead holding a wire/rope, other arm extended out; graceful balletic tension.

4) CAMERA: Full body, slight low-to-eye-level angle, mild dynamic tilt; character centered.

5) SCENE: Dark stage void with floating dust/particles; suspension wires; wooden stage floor edge lower-left; warm key lighting from upper left, strong rim light.

6) RATING VERDICT: R — leotard-clad, chest covered, emphasis on flexible pose and body lines rather than exposed or teased anatomy.

7) ACID/LSD THEME: No — palette and composition are realistic stage lighting; no kaleidoscope, prism, rainbow oil, or melting-color elements.
